purpose: Connect unchanged modern mobile frontend to local BE using explicit default-off strict loopback HTTPS mode and a fixed-target TLS relay, preserving production guards.
constraints: No production ApiHost/CSP/authentication/SQL/private config or UI/CSS edits. Existing 17 I24 cases and every production BFF guard remain.
MEDCOM_LOCAL_HTTPS opt-in server-only default off, only paired exact HTTPS localhost origins/ports; reject all other scheme/host/credential/path ambiguity. Production DNS policy unchanged.

TLS relay loopback listener and fixed loopback Node upstream only; no generic proxy, absolute-form SSRF, redirects, cookie jar, forged forwarding-header trust or cross-origin broadening. Preserve header/body/cancellation semantics and cookie isolation.

Existing trusted CurrentUser dev certificate selected explicitly without key export or trust-store mutations. Node24 Windows x64 -NodePath portable supported; TLS backend handshake must validate using system CA. No NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 or global bypass.

Launcher verifies source hashes/ports/certificate/runtime, starts/stops only owned processes, no persisted secrets/global PATH/service/firewall changes. No actual owner execution in implementation lane.

Add real built-modern-app/HTTPS relay/BFF synthetic browser proof, negative origin/CSRF/cookie/size/cleanup tests and default-off tests. No mock-only or skipped tests claimed runtime. Existing backend and frontend aggregate gates mandatory.

Root sole publisher; scoped workflow wiring may build/upload dependency-free host only after tests. Independent security/privacy review and exact-head/base CI before merge. Runtime/business activation remains unavailable.
